confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus or listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because Yogyakarta lodging prices vary widely by location and season, and July is peak tourist season. Beer, cocktail, and wine are weaker: draft beer is uncommon locally, so the beer anchor reflects a bottled domestic beer at a restaurant. Cocktail and wine values follow the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2x beer, wine about 3x beer). The FX observation was taken from RBA exchange-rate page summaries returned by search and was not independently opened or verified against the F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: budget-to-midrange Indonesian and Southeast Asian heritage tourism cities, priced below Bali's main tourist core. Food and drink are set against local warung and mid-range restaurant pricing. Lodging is set against registered guesthouses and mid-market hotels in the city's central tourist districts.
